summary: BifrOSt has typed pasteboard, typed drag and drop, the share picker and UTType conformance, all keyed by UTType ids and raw payloads. It has no Transferable protocol or TransferRepresentation for app model types, so apps cannot declare how a model type moves through copy, drag or share.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item, from_pasteboard_item, drag_item, begin_drag, drop_values); springboard/sdk/src/item_provider.rs; springboard/sdk/src/transfer_drag.rs (draggable, DropTarget); springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (share_items, paste_values); springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (show_transferable, sharing_services_for_transferable)
features.note: Sprint 10: Transferable trait with Representations builder (data, codable, file, proxy, proxy_of), exportedContentType and importedContentTypes, NSItemProvider (item_provider.rs: loadTransferable). Host tests only (sdk/tests/transferable.rs); verify on Midget for parity. Sprint 11: declarative draggable and DropTarget over drag_session (isTargeted, negotiated operation), ShareLink by representation, multi-item paste_values. Shell multi-item pasteboard wire still flat. Host tests only.

CodableRepresentation and DataRepresentation are declared on the model and reach the pasteboard and drag through one Transferable declaration (encoders are supplied as functions, no derive). Host tests export_hides_owner_types_from_other_apps_and_import_rejects_bad_bytes and exported_and_imported_types_follow_declaration_order_and_visibility (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01e.rs). The JSON and property-list encoders in springboard/sdk/src/coding.rs are not part of this evidence; verify on Midget.

FileRepresentation with sender and receiver roles and copy semantics (allow_open_in_place hands over the original). Host tests a_file_representation_hands_over_and_rebuilds_its_file, a_sent_file_opened_in_place_hands_over_the_original and a_sent_file_without_open_in_place_is_copied_to_the_receiver (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01e.rs). On a pasteboard item a file representation travels as bytes; no file promise in the shell yet, and the document-grant path for dropped files (springboard/proto/src/rich.rs, springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs) is not part of this evidence. Verify on Midget.

features.feature: Copy and paste of typed items
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs (NSPasteboard, change_count, write_objects); springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item, from_pasteboard_item); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_types.rs (Board::best); springboard/src/shell/services/pasteboard_types.rs (best method); wired: springboard/apps/clock-desktop/src/clock/stopwatch.rs (Stopwatch::export_text), springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs; springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs (write_items, write_transferable, declare_types, items, read_objects); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_item.rs (PasteboardItem); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_promise.rs (PasteboardItemDataProvider)
features.note: SDK writes carry every representation in one write and one change count step; PasteboardItem holds several types with lazy PasteboardItemDataProvider promises resolved once; declareTypes(owner) and readObjects(forClasses) are modelled. The shell still publishes one rich type to the Wayland selection (shell/pasteboard.rs follow-up). Host tests only; verify on Midget.

features.feature: Drag and drop of typed items
features.apple: draggable and dropDestination (Transferable-based), NSDraggingSource and NSDraggingDestination
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs (register_types, begin, reply, performed); springboard/sdk/src/transfer_drag.rs (draggable, DropTarget, deliver); springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (DragItem, DragPreview); wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (begin_drag, drop_values); springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs
features.note: draggable(_:) and DropTarget give a model a declarative drag source and drop destination with isTargeted and the negotiated operation (in-file tests in transfer_drag.rs drive a drag session end to end). Needs the lab machine: the shell's cross-process wire still carries the items flat, and the drop has not been checked on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (show_picker, is_inbound, show_transferable, SharingService::sharing_services_for_transferable); springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs (handles, targets, copy_text)
features.note: The share menu is built from a Transferable's exported representations (sharing_services_for_transferable and show_transferable, in-file tests in share.rs), and it shares text, URLs and granted files. Needs the lab machine: the shell's share sheet has not been checked on Midget.

features.feature: Uniform type conformance used by transfers
features.apple: UTType identifiers used as representation types (via UniformTypeIdentifiers)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. conformance and extension lookup exist; app-declared custom types for transfers were not verified

Visibility All, Team and OwnProcess filter exports; proxy_of forwards another Transferable's bytes and file representations with the stricter visibility, and an export-only forward stays export-only. Built on parity/team-k-core-transferable; not yet verified on Midget.

gaps: Transferable and TransferRepresentation exist in the SDK (Sprint 10) but are not yet adopted by apps; verify on Midget before marking parity.
The Wayland clipboard publishes only one rich type at a time (springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs:33), so typed pasteboard data does not reach other apps in full.

Shell follow-up: springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs publishes one type to the Wayland selection and keeps items flat; it needs multi-MIME data sources and item grouping so the SDK's multi-representation writes (NativePasteboard::write_items) reach other apps in full, plus file promises for file representations.
no derive-style CodableRepresentation (encoders are passed as functions); a proc-macro crate would be needed.
